# Story 01 — LOC-003 Responsive & UI Experience Enhancement (Story: CRM-92)

## Prerequisites

- Existing frontend Vue 3 app under `frontend/CRM.Web/` is running and buildable.
- Existing localization infrastructure at `frontend/CRM.Web/src/i18n/` (English + Arabic) is in place — **do not add a new i18n system**.
- No backend changes are expected. Coordinate with backend owners only if a visual change accidentally requires a payload shape change (it should not).

---

## Story Goal

Deliver a **UI/UX-only** enhancement pass over the existing CRM web app so that every existing screen:

1. Uses a **single, consistent design language** (typography, spacing, color, radius, elevation) driven from `frontend/CRM.Web/src/assets/main.css`.
2. Reuses **existing shared components** (buttons, inputs, tables, cards, badges, dialogs, empty/loading/error states) rather than duplicating page-local styles.
3. Is **responsive** at desktop, tablet, and mobile widths — no horizontal overflow, no broken tables, no unreachable controls.
4. Continues to work in both **English/LTR** and **Arabic/RTL** without regression.

**Not in scope:** new modules, new business rules, new APIs, new DB models, new auth, multi-department / multi-branch, custom branding. Do **not** change business logic or API contracts to achieve the visual improvements.

---

## Implementation tasks

### 1 — Audit and lock the design tokens in `main.css`

**File:** `frontend/CRM.Web/src/assets/main.css`

- Enumerate the CSS custom properties already declared on `:root` (colors, spacing scale, font sizes, radii, shadows, z-index). Record any missing tokens the app needs: `--space-{1..8}`, `--radius-sm/md/lg`, `--font-size-xs/sm/md/lg/xl`, `--color-surface/border/text-{primary,secondary,muted}`, `--color-status-{success,warning,danger,info}`, `--shadow-{sm,md}`, `--z-modal`, `--z-toast`.
- Add three **breakpoint variables** as CSS custom media or as SCSS-style constants documented in a comment block: mobile `≤ 640px`, tablet `641–1024px`, desktop `≥ 1025px`. Use these consistently in every subsequent media query.
- Define utility classes for consistent typography (`.text-heading-1..3`, `.text-body`, `.text-caption`), spacing (`.stack-{sm,md,lg}` vertical gap, `.inline-{sm,md,lg}` horizontal gap), and container widths (`.page-container`, `.page-container--narrow`).
- **RTL:** for every rule using `margin-left`/`right`, `padding-left`/`right`, `left`/`right`, `text-align: left`/`right`, replace with logical properties (`margin-inline-start/end`, `padding-inline-start/end`, `inset-inline-start/end`, `text-align: start/end`). This is the cheapest way to keep Arabic RTL correct without a second stylesheet.

### 2 — Consolidate shared UI primitives

Sweep `frontend/CRM.Web/src/components/` and each module's `components/` folder for **existing** primitives before creating anything new. The story explicitly forbids duplicate components.

For each of the primitives below, either enhance the existing shared component, or (if a shared version does not exist) **promote the best current instance** to `frontend/CRM.Web/src/components/` and refactor callers to import it.

- **Button** — variants `primary | secondary | ghost | danger`, sizes `sm | md`, `:loading` and `:disabled` states, min touch target 40 px on mobile.
- **Input / Select / Textarea** — label above field, error slot, help slot, consistent 40 px height desktop / 44 px mobile.
- **Table** — desktop `<table>` with sticky header; on tablet (`≤ 1024px`) collapse low-priority columns using a `hide-md` utility; on mobile (`≤ 640px`) render each row as a **card** using a `<template #row-card>` slot. Apply this to `CustomersListView`, `TicketsListView`, `PortalTicketsListView`, `AuditLogView`, `UsersAdminView`, `SlaPoliciesManagementView`, `KnowledgeBaseManagementView`, `QuickRepliesManagementView`, `CommunicationChannelsManagementView`, `ReportsView`.
- **Card / Panel** — one shared card component with header/body/footer slots; consistent padding token and radius.
- **Badge** — status and priority pill; reuse the existing `SlaBadge.vue` pattern as the reference for token-driven colors.
- **Dialog / Modal** — consistent overlay, focus trap, close button placement mirrored for RTL, mobile full-screen at `≤ 640px`. Apply to `EscalateTicketDialog.vue`, `KnowledgeBaseSearchDialog.vue`.
- **Alert / Notification** — success / warning / danger / info; consistent iconography and dismiss control.
- **Pagination** — arrow controls that mirror for RTL (use logical properties, not `transform: scaleX(-1)`).
- **LoadingState** — skeleton or spinner, consistent copy from i18n key `common.loading`.
- **EmptyState** — icon slot, title, description, optional CTA; i18n keys `common.empty.title` / `common.empty.description` fallbacks.
- **ErrorState** — icon slot, message, retry CTA; i18n key `common.error.retry`.

Add any missing keys to **both** `en/common.json` and `ar/common.json`. Do **not** introduce untranslated strings.

### 3 — Responsive `AppShell` and navigation

**File:** `frontend/CRM.Web/src/components/AppShell.vue`

- Desktop (`≥ 1025px`): fixed sidebar + top bar as today.
- Tablet (`641–1024px`): collapsible sidebar (icons + labels expand on hover / click); top bar unchanged.
- Mobile (`≤ 640px`): sidebar becomes a slide-in drawer triggered by a hamburger in the top bar; drawer slides from `inline-start` so it flips correctly in RTL.
- Ensure the main content area uses `min-width: 0` on flex children to prevent horizontal overflow from long tables/messages.
- All focusable navigation items must remain reachable via keyboard (`tabindex` order preserved).
- Preserve any `data-testid` / role selectors relied on by `frontend/CRM.Web/src/__tests__/AppShell.spec.ts`.

### 4 — Apply consistent patterns across major screens

For each view listed in **Context** section 6:

- Replace page-local button / input / card / table / dialog markup with the shared primitives from Task 2.
- Replace any local `@media` queries with the tokens/breakpoints from Task 1.
- Wrap loading fetches with `<LoadingState>`, empty results with `<EmptyState>`, error fetches with `<ErrorState>`. Do **not** invent new empty/error copy without adding it to both locales.
- Do **not** alter store actions, API calls, router guards, or field validation rules. Diffs should be limited to templates and `<style scoped>` blocks (or removal of them).

### 5 — RTL verification pass

- With `useLocale` set to `ar`, click through every major view listed in Task 4 and confirm: sidebar drawer opens from the correct edge, table column order mirrors, dialog close button sits on the leading edge, badges/icons that carry directional meaning flip using logical properties.
- Update `frontend/CRM.Web/src/__tests__/i18n.spec.ts` only if it asserts on physical (`left`/`right`) properties that have been replaced.

### 6 — No backend changes

`No backend changes required.` If a view is currently coupled to a specific response shape, keep the coupling; do not "clean it up" as part of this story.

## Edge Cases & Failure Modes

- **Very long customer / ticket titles** — must truncate with ellipsis on mobile card view, wrap on desktop table view. Enforced by the shared Table's `#row-card` slot.
- **Empty i18n key** — if a key is missing in `ar/common.json` but present in `en/common.json`, vue-i18n falls back silently and the Arabic user sees English. Any new key added by this story **must** exist in both files or CI `i18n.spec.ts` fails.
- **RTL mirroring of icons** — icons that convey direction (arrows in pagination, back button, drawer chevron) must use `inline-start/end` positioning or an explicit RTL variant. Non-directional icons (search, filter, user) must **not** mirror.
- **Sticky table header on mobile** — collapsing to cards means no sticky header; ensure the "sort" / "filter" controls remain reachable above the card list.
- **Focus trap in Dialog** — verify focus returns to the invoking button on close; on mobile full-screen, `Esc` still dismisses.
- **Horizontal overflow from `<pre>` / long URLs** in ticket messages (`TicketMessagesSection.vue`) — apply `overflow-wrap: anywhere` inside message body, not on the whole row.
- **Sidebar drawer on iOS Safari** — use `100dvh`, not `100vh`, to avoid the bottom bar hiding controls.
- **Test snapshots** — no snapshot tests currently exist under `__tests__/`, but DOM-selector tests do. Keep classes/`data-testid` used by existing specs.

## Test Plan

1. **Extend `frontend/CRM.Web/src/__tests__/AppShell.spec.ts`** — assert the mobile hamburger renders when viewport `matchMedia('(max-width: 640px)')` is true, and drawer opens/closes.
2. **Extend `frontend/CRM.Web/src/__tests__/i18n.spec.ts`** — assert `document.documentElement.dir === 'rtl'` when locale is `ar`, and that AppShell drawer slides from `inline-start` (assert a class, not a computed pixel).
3. **Add `frontend/CRM.Web/src/__tests__/DesignSystem.spec.ts`** *(new)* — mount each shared primitive (`Button`, `Input`, `Table`, `Card`, `Badge`, `Dialog`, `Alert`, `Pagination`, `LoadingState`, `EmptyState`, `ErrorState`) with default props and assert the root element carries the expected token class.
4. **Regression run** — execute the full existing suite under `frontend/CRM.Web/src/__tests__/` unchanged; all view specs must still pass because business logic and store contracts are untouched.
5. **Manual responsive smoke** — Chromium DevTools device presets at 375 × 667 (iPhone SE), 768 × 1024 (iPad), 1440 × 900 (Desktop). Walk: Login → Dashboard → Customers list → Customer profile → Tickets list → Ticket details → Reports → Portal dashboard. Repeat with locale `ar`.

---

## Verification Steps

1. **Frontend runs:** `cd frontend/CRM.Web && npm install && npm run dev` — open the app, toggle locale between `en` and `ar`, resize the browser across 360 px → 1440 px.
2. **Frontend unit tests:** `cd frontend/CRM.Web && npm run test:unit` — all specs green.
3. **Frontend build:** `cd frontend/CRM.Web && npm run build` — no TypeScript or Vite errors.
4. **Backend regression:** `cd backend && dotnet build` then `cd backend/CRM.Api.Tests && dotnet test` — must remain green (no backend files touched).
5. **Regression sweep:** Manually verify at least one create + one edit + one delete flow in Customers, Tickets, SLA Policies, Knowledge Base, Quick Replies, Users Admin — behavior identical to pre-change.
